confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Colombian coastal tourism pricing, not inspected listings or menus. Restaurant and drink anchors are moderately reliable for the Old Town and Getsemaní tourist areas; accommodation is less certain because hostel and guesthouse rates vary widely by season and neighborhood. Cocktail and wine were estimated directly and checked against beer (roughly 3x to 3.5x), since direct knowledge of bar prices is weaker. FX is from search-result snippets of the RBA homepage (4.00 pm, 14 October 2026); I did not open the RBA page or the F11.1 CSV to confirm it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Priced against Latin American coastal tourist cities with similar visitor demand, such as Santa Marta and the tourist zones of Medellín, with a premium applied for Cartagena's historic centre and Getsemaní.
